About the job

PLEASE READ FULLY BEFORE APPLYING.




META ADS SPECIALIST — POSITION OVERVIEW

We’re looking for a skilled, strategic Meta Ads Specialist (Media Buyer) to own paid social performance for our contractor client base. You’ll be responsible for both the strategy driving our Facebook and Instagram campaigns and the hands-on execution that makes them convert — generating qualified inbound leads for land clearing, excavation, and related service businesses.

This is not a pure execution role. You’ll bring a strategic perspective to audience targeting, creative direction, funnel structure, and account-level performance — while also maintaining the high execution standards our clients expect. You’ll work within our established launch SOPs as a foundation and be expected to help evolve them over time.




WHAT WE OFFER

Pay Rate: $12-$17 USD hourly

Paid Time Off (PTO): 10 days (80 hours) per year, prorated first year

Paid Holidays: 9 paid holidays per year

Location: Remote – Flexible work environment

Position Type: Full-Time

Hours: Estimated 40 hours/week

Growth and advancement opportunities




WHAT YOU’LL BE DOING

Strategy & Department Ownership

Campaign Strategy: Develop and refine our overall Meta Ads approach — including funnel structure, audience strategy, creative direction, and offer positioning — to maximize lead quality and volume across all client accounts.
Creative Strategy: Partner with our creative team to brief ad concepts, identify winning angles, and guide the development of assets that perform — not just look good.
Process Improvement: Identify gaps in our current launch SOPs and workflows, recommend improvements, and help build a scalable system for managing a growing client portfolio.

Offer Verification: Confirm all promotions, pricing, and service descriptions match client documentation before going live.




Campaign Build & Setup

Audience Targeting: Build geographic targeting to match client service areas, apply demographic filters aligned with ideal customer profiles, and configure exclusion audiences.

Three-Point Quality Gate (Required Before Every Launch)

Self Review: You personally verify every checklist item before submission.

Manager Approval: Submit the final ad creative to your Manager for sign-off via ClickUp.




Launch Monitoring & Ongoing Optimization

Post-Launch Monitoring: Monitor the initial hours after launch for delivery issues, disapprovals, or policy flags; verify ads are spending as expected.
Performance Tracking: Review key campaign metrics regularly and flag anything outside expected ranges to the Account Manager.
Daily & Monthly Audits: Conduct daily performance checks on active campaigns; run full monthly account audits.




Error Protocols

Post-Launch Errors: Pause the ad immediately, document the error and its impact, notify your manager quickly, create a corrected version, and file an incident report in the client file.
Client-Reported Errors: Acknowledge promptly, pause affected ads, and provide a corrected timeline to the Account Manager.




WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR

Must-Have Experience

3+ years managing Meta (Facebook/Instagram) ad campaigns
Experience running lead generation campaigns for service-area businesses or contractors
Experience owning strategy — not just execution — across multiple client accounts simultaneously
Strong understanding of Meta Ads Manager, campaign objectives, audience targeting, and placement optimization

Meta Business Suite
WhatConverts or similar call/lead tracking platform
GoHighLevel (GHL) or similar CRM

AI tools such as Claude for speeding up copy, research, and internal processes




Soft Skills

Strategic thinker who can see the big picture across a portfolio of accounts
Accuracy-first mentality — you proofread, test, and verify before anything goes live

Team-oriented communicator — you ask before you assume

SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE

description:
About the job

About The Company

DiDi Global Inc. is the world’s leading mobility technology platform. It offers a wide range of app-based services across markets including Asia-Pacific, Latin America and Africa, including ride hailing, taxi hailing, chauffeur, hitch and other forms of shared mobility as well as auto solutions, food delivery, intra-city freight, and financial services.

DiDi provides car owners, drivers, and delivery partners with flexible work and income opportunities. It is committed to collaborating with policymakers, the taxi industry, the automobile industry and the communities to solve the world’s transportation, environmental and employment challenges through the use of AI technology and localized smart transportation innovations. DiDi strives to create better life experiences and greater social value, by building a safe, inclusive and sustainable transportation and local services ecosystem for cities of the future.

For more information, please visit: www.didiglobal.com/news

About The Team/role

As part of DiDi's Entrega business line, B2C is a brand-new, high-potential service offering. We provide last-mile delivery solutions for businesses, fulfilling orders coming directly from their own channels (app, website, or phone). As a Senior Analyst, you will be the analytical backbone of this rapidly scaling business unit. You will bridge the gap between complex data and real-world business growth. This role is a unique hybrid of data analytics, merchant operations, and product strategy—you will not only find the "why" behind the numbers but also design the "how" to overcome business challenges.

In this role, you'll be...


Data Monitoring & Deep-Dives: Own the daily monitoring of merchant performance, volume growth, and operational health. Perform rigorous, deep-dive root-cause analyses on data anomalies, such as volume drops, or SLA breaches.
Qualitative Merchant & User Research: Lead structured interviews and feedback sessions with merchants and end-users to gather qualitative insights, ensuring we understand the story behind the data.
Translating Insights into Action: Synthesize data metrics and qualitative feedback into concrete operational action plans and structured product capability requests to continuously improve the B2C offering.
Delivery Ops Collaboration: Partner closely with the core Entrega Delivery Operations team to improve fulfillment rates, and ensure our logistics capabilities match our merchants' high expectations.



We're eager to be in touch because you have...


Experience: 2+ years of highly analytical experience within a tech platform, management consulting firm, O2O/Logistics startup, or business operations environment.
Data-Driven Acuity: A proven ability to leverage large datasets to derive meaningful, business-driving insights. Must-have: Advanced proficiency in SQL and Excel / Google Sheets
Startup Mindset: A curious and detail-oriented problem solver who takes full ownership of results. You have stellar task-management skills to navigate multiple moving parts, ensuring no task or follow-up falls through the cracks in a fast-paced, ambiguous environment
Comunication & Language: Exceptional communication and presentation skills. Fluent to native proficiency in both English and Spanish is required for working effectively within our international and cross-cultural matrix environment



You'll love working at DiDi because...

We create user value

We strive to always create valuable experiences for our users in everything we do. Our focus is to always innovate new experiences that are safe, pleasant and efficient.

We are data-driven

We are strong believers in making informed decisions, that’s why we are data-driven. We can better navigate the business landscape strategically by analyzing valuable metrics.

Win-win Collaboration

Success is a team sport. When we work to help our partners and colleagues win, we win, too. While keeping everyone's best interest at heart, we communicate with candor and execute with excellence in all we do.

We believe in integrity

Integrity is at the very core of our business. We are people who always want to do the right thing. Our intentions are sincere, we speak our minds and listen to each other.

Growth

We always strive to do better. That means venturing beyond our comfort zones, learning from our mistakes, and helping each other grow.

Diversity and Inclusion

Diversity is one of our biggest strengths. Our differences are what make us distinct. We respect each other and believe in equal opportunities for all.

We are committed to building inclusive and diverse teams

At DiDi, we believe that our differences are our biggest source of strength. That’s why we are committed to promoting equal opportunities to all candidates and employees as an Equal Opportunity Employer.

Employment and advancement decisions at DiDi are always made based on the needs of the position and the qualifications of the candidate. We do not discriminate against any employee or applicant based on their gender, age, sexual orientation, nationality, marital status, pregnancy/maternity, disability, race, religion and beliefs, or any other status protected by applicable laws wherever we operate.

We are committed to building inclusive and diverse teams, and a workplace that is free from discrimination and harassment, because that’s how we create better products and services, make better decisions and better serve the communities we’re a part of.

The Marketing Operations Specialist III is a member of the F5 Marketing Operations Team. The Marketing Operations Specialist is responsible for upholding a high standard of efficiency and organization by overseeing Marketo best practices, including the setup and organization of all program setup, data management, and reporting. Ensure scalable configuration, implementation and maintenance of all marketing programs within Marketo

Hep manage current opt-in/opt-out and all privacy policy and all compliance workflows

AI driven: experto en Claude/Chat GPT/Gemini/otros, con casos de uso claros y con impacto

Obsesión por el cliente: research continuo, entrevistas, jobs-to-be-done, y capacidad de transformar insights en ofertas y mensajes accionables

Owner mindset: foco en impacto económico (CAC, payback, margen, LTV), no en entregables
2+ años en consultoría estratégica o roles GTM/Strategy/Growth/RevOps analíticos, ideal con foco en adquisición B2B (fintech, SaaS, pagos o lending es plus)
Experiencia probada gestionando funnel completo y mejorando KPIs (enrolamientos, aprobación, activación, churn)
SQL (intermedio a avanzado) y Excel/Sheets avanzado

We act at the forefront of faith-based efforts to protect the environment, and our work is very fast-paced, with multiple projects and priorities managed daily. We enjoy a collaborative working environment in which everyone is committed to tackling the planetary crisis with courage and love. * Atención al detalle.

* Trabajo colaborativo.

* Proactividad.

* Orientación al cliente.

* Orientación a resultados.

Experiencia

Notion para gestión de requerimientos y documentación de producto.
Historias de usuario, criterios de aceptación, flujos y especificaciones funcionales.

Microsoft Office para análisis y presentación de datos.

Manejo práctico de herramientas de IA generativa como Claude, OpenAI o Gemini aplicadas al diseño y documentación de producto.

Idiomas

Inglés intermedio, verbal y escrito, para comprender documentación y comunicarse en situaciones relacionadas con el producto.

Habilidades

Pensamiento analítico y estructurado para entender problemas, procesos y datos.
Excelente comunicación escrita y verbal para traducir necesidades de negocio en requerimientos claros.
Orientación al detalle y a la calidad, especialmente durante el diseño, documentación y ejecución de pruebas.

Proactividad y autonomía para gestionar requerimientos de principio a fin.

Persona was founded in 2018 by two Stanford graduates on a simple idea: talent is everywhere, but opportunity isn't. By recruiting globally for specific client roles, we've grown into one of the fastest-growing companies in the global staffing industry. Every applicant goes through the same steps, and each one is designed to let you show what you can actually do.




We hire people who care about the craft of their work, take ownership without being asked, and want to build a career rather than just hold a job. If that's you, and one of our open roles fits, we'd like to meet you.

description:
About the job

At Lyft, our purpose is to serve and connect. We aim to achieve this by cultivating a work environment where all team members belong and have the opportunity to thrive.

Customer Impact sits at the intersection of customer experience and engineering accountability. As an Associate on the Bug Review team, you will investigate flawed user experiences, verify and escalate bugs through structured cross-functional workflows, and drive visibility on open platform issues so resolution doesn't stall. Bug Review is the triage layer to separate signal from noise, ensuring Engineering receives verified, credible escalations instead of a flood of unvetted reports.

The Bug Review Associate is the front line of that triage layer. You'll investigate incoming bug reports, verify reproducibility and impact, and manage tickets through their Jira lifecycle, turning raw customer signal into evidence Engineering can act on. This is a high-volume, detail-driven role: you'll work a defined queue of tickets each day, applying consistent investigation standards so that what reaches our Sr. Specialists and Engineering is already vetted.

Because many of the reports you're investigating come from riders or drivers who had a genuinely bad experience, this role also requires direct, empathetic communication with customers. You're often the person following up on an issue that upset them.

This role is part of a new HQ Associate model based in Mexico, built to bring bug review in-house with tighter tooling access, stronger quality control, and closer partnership with the broader teams. Associates report directly into the Customer Impact structure.

description:
About the job

Who we are

About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies - from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups - use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone's reach while doing the most important work of your career.

About The Team

The Alliances and Channels (A&C) team builds and scales the partner ecosystem that powers Stripe's growth. We work with SaaS platforms, technology partners, and services partners to drive merchant acquisition and expand Stripe's reach across markets. In LATAM, partners are a the primary growth engine — and this role sits at the center of that motion.

What you’ll do

This role sits at the intersection of partner development and channel sales. You'll own the full lifecycle of SaaS platform partnerships across LATAM — recruiting and developing vertical platforms that embed Stripe into their products, then activating and growing those relationships into meaningful contributors to regional revenue.

Working closely with Stripe Account Executives, you'll drive joint go-to-market motions, identify high-value opportunities within your partner portfolio, and own the co-sell pipeline from sourcing through to close. Expect a mix of partner engagement (enablement, solution development, business reviews), sales engagement (opportunity qualification and pipeline progression), and direct user engagement (prospecting, activation).This role requires a high level of dynamism and the ability to adapt to evolving business strategies and changing conditions. We are looking for someone who feels comfortable working in ambiguity and who can quickly adjust to new priorities, changes, and strategic shifts as the business evolves.

Responsibilities


Identify, recruit, and develop a portfolio of SaaS platform partners and community services partners across LATAM, with a primary focus on Mexico and support for Brazilian partners.
Own the full partner lifecycle — from first contact through onboarding, enablement, activation, and long-term growth
Drive joint go-to-market and co-selling initiatives with your partner portfolio; own forecasting across Partner Sourced Opportunities, Co-Sell, and Product Live metrics
Work directly alongside Stripe AEs on co-sell opportunities, supporting the full deal cycle from pipeline sourcing through to close
Enable Stripe and partner sales teams on the joint value proposition; lead partner business reviews, account mapping workshops, and enablement sessions
Serve as an advocate for partners within Stripe and represent Stripe within partner organizations
Support LATAM's Retail, Insurance, Travel and Hospitality strategy through active engagement with relevant services, platform, and technology partners



Who you are

We're looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.

Minimum Requirements


8+ years in partner management, channel sales, or a combination of both at a technology company, with a demonstrated track record of building and scaling SaaS platform partnerships in Mexico
Experience working with vertical SaaS platforms and Technology companies in Financial services, Travel and Hospitality, Retail, or adjacent industries
Experience working in multi-party sales cycles, including co-sell and channel motions
Familiarity with the payments, commerce, or fintech landscape
Strong communication and presentation skills, able to engage partner and customer leadership internally and externally



Preferred Qualifications


Familiarity with the Brazilian market, alongside strong written and verbal proficiency in English and Portuguese
Experience with ISVs or platform ecosystems such as Oracle, Salesforce, or SAP
Demonstrated comfort with AI tools in day-to-day work



In-office expectations

Office-assigned Stripes in most of our locations are currently expected to spend at least 50% of the time in a given month in their local office or with users. This expectation may vary depending on role, team and location. For example, Stripes in Stripe Delivery Center roles in Mexico City, Mexico, Bengaluru, India, and Dublin, Ireland work 100% from the office. Also, some teams have greater in-office attendance requirements, to appropriately support our users and workflows, which the hiring manager will discuss. This approach helps strike a balance between bringing people together for in-person collaboration and learning from each other, while supporting flexibility when possible.

Pay and benefits

Stripe does not yet include pay ranges in job postings in every country. Stripe strongly values pay transparency and is working toward pay transparency globally.

We look forward to hearing from you.

At Stripe, we're looking for people with passion, grit, and integrity. You're encouraged to apply even if your experience doesn't precisely match the job description. Your skills and passion will stand out—and set you apart—especially if your career has taken some extraordinary twists and turns. At Stripe, we welcome diverse perspectives and people who think rigorously and aren't afraid to challenge assumptions. Join us.

Apply now

description:
About the job

About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies—from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups—use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone’s reach while doing the most important work of your career.

About The Team

The Payments organization owns some of Stripe’s most critical payment flows and a platform that processes hundreds of billions of dollars in payments a year. Our team is responsible for translating complex partner specifications related to network costs (interchange and scheme fees) into simplified logic for internal and external consumption. This also drives decisions and product recommendations to manage the underlying network costs paid by Stripe and our users. The team partners closely with the engineering, product, finance, and partnership groups to manage and understand Stripe’s network costs.

Our work is core to Stripe’s business, as Technical Operations roles in Payments are a dynamic and key component of Stripe's success. We sit at the intersection of product/platform engineers and financial partners, connecting them to ensure that everyone thrives and nothing is lost in translation.

What you’ll do

We are looking to add payment enthusiasts who enjoy interpreting complex cost structures and ever changing payment network systems in order to optimize on behalf of Stripe and our users. You will be instrumental in building Stripe’s approach to managing our global network cost base.

Responsibilities


Collaborate across the company, including engineering, accounting, financial partnerships and product teams, to analyze billions of dollars moving through the Stripe platform.
Translate network specifications into implementation instructions to create billing models for new and revised fees (both scheme and interchange)
Influence product strategy to minimize network costs
Work with Product and Engineering to implement cost saving opportunities
Partner with Finance to prioritize areas for investment and explain trends in costs and margin impact
Monitor and maintain the accuracy of the fees through validation and alerting
Creating fee explainability to internal and external stakeholders
Hosting education sessions for internal teams to scale knowledge
Introduce data and process efficiencies to meet the scale and speed of Stripe. Identify and automate inefficient operational processes to reduce manual workloads
Scale our network cost operation by driving the design, documentation, and training of operational processes to leverage partner relationships.



Who you are

We’re looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.

Minimum Requirements


* Have 5+ years of in Payments at a leading technology or payments company
Have experience writing SQL to query relational databases
Have experience managing communications and workflows with technical and non-technical teams across internal and external stakeholders
Experience mentoring junior team members in technical skill development, operational strategy and problem solving
Have experience navigating the nuanced complexity of financial systems and solving large scale, technical challenges

In-office expectations

Office-assigned Stripes in most of our locations are currently expected to spend at least 50% of the time in a given month in their local office or with users. This expectation may vary depending on role, team and location. For example, Stripes in Stripe Delivery Center roles in Mexico City, Mexico, Bengaluru, India, and Dublin, Ireland work 100% from the office. Also, some teams have greater in-office attendance requirements, to appropriately support our users and workflows, which the hiring manager will discuss. This approach helps strike a balance between bringing people together for in-person collaboration and learning from each other, while supporting flexibility when possible.

Pay and benefits

Stripe does not yet include pay ranges in job postings in every country. Stripe strongly values pay transparency and is working toward pay transparency globally.

We look forward to hearing from you.

At Stripe, we're looking for people with passion, grit, and integrity. You're encouraged to apply even if your experience doesn't precisely match the job description. Your skills and passion will stand out—and set you apart—especially if your career has taken some extraordinary twists and turns. At Stripe, we welcome diverse perspectives and people who think rigorously and aren't afraid to challenge assumptions. Join us.

description:
About the job

Farmacias del Ahorro es una compañía 100% mexicana, dedicada a proveer servicios de salud y bienestar a todos los mexicanos. Con una destacada trayectoria de más de 30 años en el mercado, hemos logrado un crecimiento firme y constante, brindando servicio a través de nuestras más de 1,800 sucursales y un gran equipo de trabajo mayor a 22,000 colaboradores. Somos la cadena farmacéutica líder a nivel nacional. ¡Únete a nuestro equipo!




Descripción general:

Transformar los datos de experiencia del cliente (VoC) e información transaccional en inteligencia financiera y predictiva. Su meta es cuantificar el impacto económico de las fallas de servicio, construir casos de negocio (costo-beneficio) y prevenir la deserción (churn), dictando a la operación exactamente dónde invertir esfuerzos para maximizar la rentabilidad y la lealtad.




Funciones generales:

Traducción financiera de CX: Programar en SQL y Python para cruzar datos de experiencia (NPS, CES, CSAT) con transacciones financieras, calculando el impacto real de las fallas en el negocio (caída de ingresos, ticket promedio, etc.).
Priorización analítica de fricciones: Diagnosticar causas raíz de mala experiencia y construir casos de negocio utilizando matrices de costo-beneficio para definir qué correcciones operativas son viables y urgentes.
Modelado y prevención de churn: Conectar los hallazgos de Voz del Cliente (VoC) con los modelos de segmentación interna (VACE) para identificar proactivamente clústeres de clientes en riesgo de deserción.
Auditoría y exigencia operativa: Supervisar y auditar de manera empírica que las áreas operativas ejecuten las correcciones priorizadas, midiendo el impacto real en los indicadores tras la intervención.
Ingeniería de datos VoC: Desarrollar, optimizar y mantener el código necesario para automatizar la limpieza, categorización y análisis de datos de clientes, garantizando la escalabilidad del sistema.




Requerimientos y criterios de selección:

Licenciatura / Ingeniería en Actuaría, Físico Matemático o afín.
Experiencia 3+ años en análisis de información, evaluación financiera de proyectos (casos de negocio y cálculo de ROI), Modelado de clientes y segmentación de valor (VACE, RFM, propensión al churn). Dominio matemático de métricas CX (NPS, CES, CSAT).
Herramientas: SQL avanzado, Python (Pandas, NumPy, análisis estadístico y minería de datos).




Modelo de trabajo:

Presencial

Promovemos y verificamos la adopción de medidas a favor de la igualdad de oportunidades y la eliminación de toda forma de discriminación en cualquiera de nuestros procesos de selección y en nuestros centros de trabajo. Nunca te solicitaremos ningún tipo de pago como parte del proceso de reclutamiento, toma precauciones y evita caer en fraude.

About the job

About Us

We’re building the world’s leading cross-border fintech for emerging markets - empowering families, fueling local economies, and changing how millions access financial services.

Since our launch in 2019, we have transformed how money moves across borders with our operations spanning 6 out of 7 continents and covering both the busiest and most underserved (remittance) corridors. We tapped into a massive shift - from banks to phones - bringing digital finance to places where traditional systems never reached. The next stage of growth will fuel a network of services and products especially designed to make money more accessible to diaspora communities including local cards, and additional savings and payments features.

We’re growing fast, backed by world-class investors, and scaling a product that blends real world impact with cutting edge fintech innovation.

Here’s a Little More


Founded by Harvard grads and 3-time founders who previously built Segovia (acquired) and GiveDirectly (>$300M revenue, fastest-growing NGO in the world)

You will conduct deep customer research to understand the emotional side of sending money home; execute high-impact partnerships; and drive boots-on-the-ground awareness to win against our real competition: the in-person remittance counters at Latino supermarkets.

Reporting to our Regional Manager, Latam, you’ll combine great sales and marketing prowess with a data-driven test-and-learn mindset. You’ll be a creative thinker who is always looking for ways to hack growth

The role offers the chance to join a high growth startup and to have a positive impact on the communities we serve. We are looking for a candidate with an immigrant background or a deep, lived understanding of remittance culture. You should have an entrepreneurial spirit, a test-and-learn mindset, and the execution power to drive seasonal campaigns (e.g., Father's Day, back-to-school) from idea to implementation.

About the job

Overview

Careers to Smile About

At PepsiCo, you’ll discover a place where our mission is to create smiles around the world. With a portfolio of more than 500 beloved brands including, Gatorade, Lay’s and Quaker, our work touches millions of people every day.

At the heart of the company is a team of thinkers, creators, and problem-solvers who collaborate to innovate and turn ideas into action. Driven by innovation and a focus on creating joyful moments through food and drinks, our decisions are guided by consumer centricity, creating opportunities for our associates to do meaningful work and make a lasting impact in the communities we serve.

Whatever your role, you’ll be part of a global community that values your ideas and empowers you to make an impact, on your career and on the world around you.

Responsibilities

The Opportunity

The Procurement Sr. Manager – LATAM CAPEX will be responsible for designing, leading and implementing the Global CAPEX Strategy in LATAM, executing and implementing the sourcing strategies for Civil Works, Installations, Manufacturing, Packaging & Sustainability CAPEX categories. This position reports to the Global CAPEX leader and is responsible for a managed spend of approximately $530 million over 15 countries, 38 Plants, +400DCs and 9HQ.

This position is key to support the Procurement transformation and lead the agenda within CAPEX teams by integrating all LATAM while driving +20MM Productivity per year, and supporting other strategic agendas such as sustainability, BCP, digitalization and growth strategies.

Your Impact

As Procurement Sr. Manager - LATAM CAPEX your scope would consist of:


Develop and execute PSP and AOP CAPEX Plan on each BU with MSO’s alignment.
Ensure GP Policy Comply supported on Sourcing Strategy, applying 7 step methodology.
Develop and excecute Category Strategy:
Spend mapping for the Category.
Develop 3 year Strategy for each Sub-Category, understanding market trends and BOUs needs.
Understand each BOU business needs and economic / political situation.
Build partnership relations with functions, GP and MSO’s to guarantee proper excecution and alignment.
Ensure appropriate reporting and the impact of procurement initiatives in LATAM P&L.
Guarantee early notice with key staleholders and report of incidents in order to avoid any Business disruption.
Guarantee fluent communication with finance teams to forecast prices and updates.
Support the LATAM transformation of Indirects procurement by adoption and leverage of digitalization agenda (SpendHQ, Cirtuo, etc).
Sustainably deliver +6% cs productivity.
Support Career Plans to guarantee people development and backfields.


Qualifications

Who Are We Looking For?


Bachelor Degree in Business Engineering, Administration, Economics, Industrial Engineering.
Excellent Functional knowledge (+8 years in category management roles): depth in facilities/service category management processes and tools and other related categories in complex environment is desired, preferably within Food & Beverage industry.
Strong knowledge of strategic sourcing processes and procurement best practices, with experience of implementing them in a regional/global environment.
Experience leading regional teams is desirable.
Ability to build relationships and influence across a matrix organization.
Strong grasp of general business economics & key cost & quality drivers.
Strong analytical & financial skills.
Experience with Ariba (RFPs, RFIs, e-auctions) and SAP.
Political & commercial savvy.
Ability to translate complex situations into simple messages for Executive level communication.
Results and action orientated: Comfortable setting and delivering against bold, stretch targets.
Excellent language skills: Spanish and English essential, both verbal and in writing. Portuguese desirable.
Understands the business cultures around LATAM sectors and the sensitivities that go along with it.


If this is an opportunity that interests you, we encourage you to apply even if you do not meet 100% of the requirements.

What can you expect from us:


Opportunities to learn and develop every day through a wide range of programs.
Internal digital platforms that promote self-learning.
Development programs according to Leadership skills.
Specialized training according to the role.
Learning experiences with internal and external providers.
We love to celebrate success, which is why we have recognition programs for seniority, behavior, leadership, moments of life, among others.
Financial wellness programs that will help you reach your goals in all stages of life.
A flexibility program that will allow you to balance your personal and work life, adapting your working day to your lifestyle.
And because your family is also important to us, they can also enjoy benefits such as our Wellness Line, thousands of Agreements and Discounts, Scholarship programs for your children, Aid Plans for different moments of life, among others.


We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate based on race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. We respect and value diversity as a work force and innovation for the organization.

title: Quality Assurance Food Technologist
skills: Lead and manage the quality assurance programs, policies and initiatives for specific product category(s). Responsible for developing inspection, testing and quality control procedures, design of quality training programs, investigation of customer complaint issues and facilitation of quality audits.
Responsible for managing assigned product category, during corporate product recalls, withdrawals and maintains required documentation.

Use chemistry, microbiology, engineering, and other sciences to study the principles underlying the processing and deterioration of foods. Research ways to make processed foods safe, palatable, and healthful.
Partner with Purchasing and Research and Development for continuous improvement and cost savings for specific product categories while maintaining and improving quality.

Ensure all Food and Drug Administration (FDA), Hazzard Analysis Critical Control Points (HACCP) and Safe Quality Foods (SQF) and all other regulatory requirements are met and maintained. Research and provide recommendations as needed.
Implement, maintain and update policies, procedures, specifications and programs that ensure product safety and quality.
Determine and recommend best practices in the industry including the best way to process, package, preserve, store and distribute food.
Manage supplier relationships relative to quality, food safety issues and innovation for relative product category(s). Identify and resolve supplier food safety and quality issues.
Handles all communication of product specification changes through appropriate channels to ensure change management success.
Coordinates the receiving and testing of product samples from all distribution centers as per set schedule.
Partner with Purchasing and R&D for continuous improvement and cost savings.
Performs other duties as assigned by the Director of Quality Assurance.
Bachelor’s degree in food science, Biology, Chemistry or related discipline or equivalent experience.
Minimum of two (2) years Food Technology and Quality Assurance experience in the food industry with experience in one or more of the following:
Food chemistries and microbiology
HAACP, SQF and British Retail Consortium (BRC) requirements and metrics.
FSMA and how it affects suppliers, warehouses and product transport.
Knowledge of food industry manufacturing practices and familiarity with FDA and USDA regulations as they pertain to assigned product categories. This will include OSHA lab standards.
Ability to communicate effectively with franchisees, vendors and other departments. Ability to communicate complex technical data in an understanding way to a variety of audiences.
Ability to establish, document, update and track quality metrics through standardized and accepted process control procedures.
Demonstrated accuracy and attention to detail in the documentation of issues, resolutions, root cause, preventive controls and policy changes.
Excellent problem-solving and decision-making skills. Demonstrated ability to make sound, business decisions using the best data available. Able to resolve conflicts and gain consensus.
Excellent interpersonal and teamwork skills and ability to work cross-functionally with individuals and teams.
Demonstrated ability to prioritize and manage multiple, complex projects and initiatives simultaneously with a results-oriented approach.
Computer proficiency (Microsoft Office, database, Internet and documentation software required.
Sensory abilities for product evaluation.
Knowledge/experience in the Quick Service restaurant industry.
Masters’ degree in Food Science, Biology, Chemistry or related discipline.
Position requires working in both an office and test kitchen environment.
Position requires field work in manufacturing plants.
Position will require occasional travel via a variety of transportation modes for field food product testing and research.

About the job

Why Housecall Pro?

Help us build solutions that build better lives. At Housecall Pro, we show up to work every day to make a difference for real people: the home service professionals that support America’s 100 million homes. We’re all about the Pro, and dedicate our days to helping them streamline operations, scale their businesses, and—ultimately—save time so they can be with their families and live well.

While our headquarters are based in Denver, Colorado, our team spans the globe, with teammates across Brazil, Poland, the Philippines, Mexico, and beyond. We care deeply about our customers and foster a culture where our company, people and Pros grow and succeed together—no matter where they’re based. Leadership is as focused on growing team members’ careers as they expect their teams to be on creating solutions for Pros.

We Also Offer


Paid holidays and flexible, take-it-as-you-need-it scheduled time off
A culture built on innovation that values big ideas, no matter where they come from


Role Overview

As a Specialist, Onboarding, you are a professional who thrives in ensuring a seamless and positive onboarding experience for our service professionals (our Pros) to our platform. You are responsible for coordinating and facilitating customer onboarding, while providing exceptional customer service and answering Pros' questions and concerns.

As the dedicated and primary point of contact during the most critical window post-enrollment, you take ownership of the Pro experience, guiding them through early adoption, building confidence, and ensuring they realize value quickly. You bring a proactive approach to addressing challenges, empathy, and problem-solving skills to help better our team and improve the lives of our Pros. You operate with an ownership mindset, acting as a continuation of the sales experience by reinforcing the value of HCP and ensuring Pros feel confident they made the right decision.

Our team is passionate, empathetic, hard working, and above all else focused on improving the lives of our Pros. Our success is their success.

What You Do Each Day

Eloquently troubleshoot technical issues, have deep product knowledge, and think outside the box for solutions

Housecall Pro is growing fast and we’re scaling our team to help enable and accelerate our growth.

Housecall Pro’s brand portfolio includes Business Coaching by Housecall Pro, a business coaching solution for home services businesses. Our brands are united by a singular mission to champion our Pros to success.

description:
About the job

Who we are

About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies—from the world's largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups—use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone's reach while doing the most important work of your career.

At Stripe, our Mexico City office is a vibrant hub at the forefront of our mission to reshape the financial landscape for businesses worldwide. Our team prioritizes collaboration, innovation, and excellence. As a member of the Mexico City team, you'll be part of a mission-driven community dedicated to enhancing the global economy and increasing the GDP of the internet. We strive for excellence by creating with craft and beauty, while having fun and celebrating our successes together.

We cultivate a culture of collaboration, inclusivity, and support where every team member's voice matters. Our commitment shines through as we handle over a million support cases each year, empowering our users not just to solve problems but to achieve their goals.

About The Team

Stripe was built with simplicity in mind. We strive to deliver frictionless experiences for all of our users, whether they are an Independent Business, Startup, SMB, or Enterprise, and our mission is to provide all Stripe users with the best support experience possible. Today, Stripe handles over a million support cases per year and processes millions of internal transactions. We're going to achieve excellence by thinking of support in a novel, solution-oriented way, and viewing operations as an integral enabler of all of Stripe's growth.

Stripe has unique operational problems resulting from both our type of scale and the type of businesses we partner with as a result of "growing the GDP of the internet." Stripes leverage their understanding of our products, the financial industry and money movement, and our processes to support both internal and external users. Doing so requires us to invest significant resources into building this experience ourselves.

What you'll do

The role of Ops Associate can be interpreted as a Stripe "athlete" that will engage in either internal-facing or external-facing (e.g., support, risk) workflows, or both. OA roles will be highly operational in nature and will largely be aligned with case-level or process-type work. OAs will work on workflows which are considered to be "medium complexity" or sensitive in nature, therefore requiring internal Stripe-level systems and tools access, meaning that it cannot be outsourced. As the SDC matures and capability is established, we can expect the complexity of work at SDC to increase, and additionally aspire to drive improvements in the work we are responsible for.

Responsibilities


Deliver exceptional Stripe experience by efficiently and accurately resolving issues across social media platforms (e.g., X, LinkedIn, Facebook, and others)
Help resolve issues that are escalated via social media, including technical product questions, and work to prevent those issues from happening again
Partner with internal teams across Stripe (e.g., Comms, Incident Ops, Risk), serving as the ultimate escalation point for high-stakes user issues and proactively initiating incident reports with a user-first mindset
Coordinate executive escalations from Stripe's leaders with other teams
Contribute to and manage new programs focused on improving the Stripe user experience
Identify operational process gaps and initiate continuous improvements to accelerate global scale while delivering an exceptional experience for Stripe users
Be part of building a brand-new team and operational culture for Stripe



Who you are

We're looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.

Minimum Requirements


You have experience with social media support or an interest in resolving user issues through those channels (e.g., Twitter, LinkedIn, Facebook).
You have prior experience in customer support and external user-facing operations.
You have a user-first mindset and are energized by the challenge of solving difficult problems, leveraging a process-oriented approach and a curiosity for technical products.
You have excellent communication skills, both written and verbal.
You excel in analytical thinking and problem solving.
You have a process-oriented mindset and ability to get things done.
You enjoy working in an in-office environment with strong cross-team collaboration and support.
You are able to prioritize and enjoy working in a quick-moving environment.
You are humble and have a proven track record for working well across teams and with external partners.
You're willing to work a weekend day for which you will receive a weekday off in lieu. The CDMX Operations team operates during daytime hours in 9-hour shifts (including 1-hour paid lunch break) scheduled to fall between the hours of 6am and 10pm.



Preferred Qualifications


Prior experience or knowledge in user support
Prior experience working on projects or process improvement initiatives
Prior experience or technical proficiency with Sprinklr will be an added advantage.



In-office expectations

Office-assigned Stripes in most of our locations are currently expected to spend at least 50% of the time in a given month in their local office or with users. This expectation may vary depending on role, team and location. For example, Stripes in Stripe Delivery Center roles in Mexico City, Mexico, Bengaluru, India, and Dublin, Ireland work 100% from the office. Also, some teams have greater in-office attendance requirements, to appropriately support our users and workflows, which the hiring manager will discuss. This approach helps strike a balance between bringing people together for in-person collaboration and learning from each other, while supporting flexibility when possible.

Pay and benefits

Stripe does not yet include pay ranges in job postings in every country. Stripe strongly values pay transparency and is working toward pay transparency globally.

We look forward to hearing from you.

At Stripe, we're looking for people with passion, grit, and integrity. You're encouraged to apply even if your experience doesn't precisely match the job description. Your skills and passion will stand out—and set you apart—especially if your career has taken some extraordinary twists and turns. At Stripe, we welcome diverse perspectives and people who think rigorously and aren't afraid to challenge assumptions. Join us.

Apply now

You will personally build, launch, manage, and optimize Meta and Google Ads campaigns while looking beyond the ad platforms to understand what is actually driving leads, appointments, showroom visits, and sales.
You will decide how campaigns should be structured, what gets tested and why, when to scale or pull back, and whether the data you are optimizing against can be trusted.

When performance drops, you should be able to determine whether the bottleneck is paid media, creative, landing page conversion, lead quality, CRM follow up, attribution, or another part of the funnel, then develop and implement the solution.
When needed, you should also be comfortable making changes to funnels, follow up sequences, and automation workflows.
Salary between $2,000 - $3,500 (Depending on experience).
Performance & growth bonuses.
You will review account performance, pacing, lead volume, creative performance, funnel metrics, and lead quality.
You will optimize campaigns, launch tests, develop new strategies, review CRM conversations, and identify opportunities to improve client performance.
When creative, funnel, CRM, tracking, or technical changes are needed, you will collaborate with the appropriate team members while remaining accountable for moving the solution forward.
Depending on the situation, you may also communicate directly with dealership clients and explain complex strategies and performance data in simple business terms.
Location: Remote
Work Schedule, Non-Negotiable: Monday through Friday, 9:00 AM to 6:00 PM Eastern Time, U.S.
You must be able to work these exact hours consistently regardless of location.
description:
About the job

About Metta Dealers:




Metta Dealers is a performance marketing agency that partners with car dealerships across the U.S. to help them generate more qualified showroom traffic so they can sell more cars.




We manage the entire customer-acquisition journey—not just the advertising platforms. Our work includes paid media, creative strategy, landing pages, conversion tracking, CRM follow-up, attribution, and sales-funnel analysis.




Experience & Requirements:

This is a specialized agency-side lead-generation position. To qualify, your work history must clearly demonstrate:




•4+ years working inside a digital marketing agency, personally managing at least 10 active client accounts simultaneously with over 30k monthly advertising budgets.

• 2+ years or more managing local or appointment-based lead generation campaigns for businesses such as automotive, legal, home services, medical, dental, real estate, or similar industries.

• ADVANCED hands-on experience with Meta and Google search lead generation campaigns. You must have owned the campaigns yourself, not simply supervised others or reviewed reports.

• Strong understanding of CPM, CTR, CPC, conversion rate, CPL, contact rate, appointment rate, show rate, close rate, ROAS, and cost per sale.

• C1–C2 spoken English.

• Big Plus: Direct automotive marketing experience or a working understanding of dealership lead generation, CRM follow up, appointments, showroom traffic, financing, and vehicle sales.




About This Position:

We are looking for a senior performance marketer to own advertising performance across a portfolio of dealership accounts.
You will personally build, launch, manage, and optimize Meta and Google Ads campaigns while looking beyond the ad platforms to understand what is actually driving leads, appointments, showroom visits, and sales.
You will decide how campaigns should be structured, what gets tested and why, when to scale or pull back, and whether the data you are optimizing against can be trusted.
When performance drops, you should be able to determine whether the bottleneck is paid media, creative, landing page conversion, lead quality, CRM follow up, attribution, or another part of the funnel, then develop and implement the solution.
When needed, you should also be comfortable making changes to funnels, follow up sequences, and automation workflows.




Compensation

Salary between $2,000 - $3,500 (Depending on experience).
Performance & growth bonuses.




What Success Looks Like

You notice performance problems before someone points them out.




You understand how performance connects across: Traffic → Lead → Conversation → Appointment → Show → Sold




You think beyond CPL and understand how advertising decisions affect dealership sales.

You proactively identify new creative angles, campaign strategies, offers, and testing opportunities.

When something is not working, you have a theory, investigate it, and take ownership of solving it.




You can clearly explain what is happening, why it is happening, and what should happen next.




A Day In This Role

You will review account performance, pacing, lead volume, creative performance, funnel metrics, and lead quality.
You will optimize campaigns, launch tests, develop new strategies, review CRM conversations, and identify opportunities to improve client performance.
When creative, funnel, CRM, tracking, or technical changes are needed, you will collaborate with the appropriate team members while remaining accountable for moving the solution forward.
Depending on the situation, you may also communicate directly with dealership clients and explain complex strategies and performance data in simple business terms.




You’ll Do Well Here If

• You think about business outcomes, not just advertising metrics

• You surface problems and recommendations before someone asks

• You can confidently do a full funnel diagnosis

• You want to understand why performance changed, not simply react to it

• You stay current on Meta, Google, creative strategy, advertising trends, and new tools

• You are comfortable making judgment calls and defending them with data

• You take ownership and prefer solving problems over escalating them




This Probably Isn’t For You If

• You have never worked for a marketing agency before

• You need someone else to tell you what to do inside the ad accounts

• You stop paying attention once the lead is generated

• You are not interested in creative strategy or what happens after the click (e.g., your experience is strictly in Shopify, dropshipping, or DTC product e-commerce rather than appointment-based pipelines).

• You prefer executing tasks over diagnosing problems and developing solutions

• You need constant oversight to keep accounts moving




Schedule Details

Location: Remote
Work Schedule, Non-Negotiable: Monday through Friday, 9:00 AM to 6:00 PM Eastern Time, U.S.
You must be able to work these exact hours consistently regardless of location.




Why Metta Dealers?

• Competitive starting salary with performance-based bonus opportunities

• Long term growth potential within a fast growing, performance focused agency

• High autonomy with clear expectations and ownership

• Full time remote position with structure and flexibility

• Paid U.S. holidays

• Paid time off




REQUIRED SKILLS: Lead Generation, Customer Relationship Management (CRM), Local Marketing, Meta Ads, Google Ads, Account Management, Conversion Rate Optimization (CRO), B2C Marketing, Web Analytics, Media Buying

description:
About the job

About Us

SharkNinja is a global product design and technology company, with a diversified portfolio of 5-star rated lifestyle solutions that positively impact people’s lives in homes around the world. Powered by two trusted, global brands, Shark and Ninja, the company has a proven track record of bringing disruptive innovation to market and developing one consumer product after another has allowed SharkNinja to enter multiple product categories, driving significant growth and market share gains. Headquartered in Needham, Massachusetts with more than 4,100 associates, the company’s products are sold at key retailers, online and offline, and through distributors around the world.

AI at SharkNinja 

At SharkNinja, we’re building an AI-native culture. We’re not waiting for the future; we’re creating it. Our people are expected to experiment boldly, adopt new tools, and continuously raise what’s possible to create meaningful impact for our consumers. If you believe the best way to do your job hasn’t been invented yet, you’ll fit right in.

Digital Sharks: Hunting Attention, Converting to Revenue

Marketplace Affiliates Associate (Early Careers)

Team: Global eCommerce, Pure Players — Marketplace Affiliates

Location: Mexico City, Mexico

Contract Type: Fixed-Term Contract

Duration: 6 months

Overview

At SharkNinja, we don’t just build products—we create consumer-first experiences that delight millions of customers around the world.

Digital Sharks is our early careers program for the eCommerce Pure Players business — the team responsible for how SharkNinja shows up on the world’s largest marketplaces, including Amazon, Mercado Libre and Takealot. Millions of people discover our products there every day. This program exists to turn that attention into revenue.

We’re looking for a Marketplace Affiliates Associate to join our Pure Players Marketplace Affiliates team and build our affiliate presence on the world’s largest marketplaces.

Affiliate and creator content is one of the fastest growing routes to the marketplace shopper, and one we have barely used outside the US. You will be among the first to run at it seriously in your market — getting content live, learning what works, and writing the strategy off the back of real results rather than assumptions.

This is an exciting opportunity for someone who is entrepreneurial, creative and comfortable starting from a blank page, and wants to build hands-on experience in affiliate and creator marketing within a fast-paced, global business.

What You’ll Be Doing

You’ll own a defined market and a measurable business outcome from your first month, while gaining exposure to how a global e-commerce business actually operates.

You’ll


Get 100 pieces of affiliate content live in your market within your first 30-day sprint.
Run tests outside of Creator Connections in the US and through central affiliate go-to-market in your region.
Draw clear implications from the results and write them into our Centre of Excellence playbook.
Identify, contact and onboard creators and affiliate partners in market.
Track performance by format, creator and category, and build a defensible view of what converts.
Work with Sales and Digital Marketing to make sure affiliate traffic lands on pages that are ready to convert.
Prepare recommendations and stakeholder updates for regional and central teams.
Participate in the program operating rhythm, including daily stand-ups, 30-day sprint reviews and weekly Show & Tell sessions where you present your own work.


What We’re Looking For

We’re looking for someone who enjoys solving problems, asking questions and working collaboratively to get to a better answer.

You’ll Likely Be


A recent graduate, or in the final year of a degree in Marketing, Communications, Business, Media or a related discipline.
Entrepreneurial and comfortable with ambiguity — this part of the program has no established playbook.
Genuinely interested in creators, content and how people are persuaded to buy online.
Analytical and comfortable working with data to identify trends and support decision making.
A confident communicator who can turn complex information into something clear and actionable.
Proactive, collaborative and eager to learn.
Comfortable managing multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.
Confident using Microsoft Office, particularly Excel and PowerPoint.
Working fluency in English is required.


It Would Be Great If You Also Have


Exposure to affiliate, influencer or creator marketing, including your own content.
An interest in social commerce and creator economics.
Experience using reporting or data visualisation tools.
Familiarity with affiliate tracking or attribution platforms such as Impact, Levanta or Creator Connections.
Additional language skills relevant to your market.


What You’ll Gain

At SharkNinja, you’ll be trusted with meaningful work from day one.

You’ll own a named market and a named business outcome, working alongside experienced commercial leaders on results the business is measured by.

You’ll Benefit From


Ownership of a defined market and a measurable business outcome from your first month.
Mentoring and coaching from an experienced manager, plus a named mentor one level above them.
Direct exposure to the world’s largest marketplaces — Amazon, Mercado Libre and Takealot.
Hands-on experience with AI-native tools, including our Agentic Jailbreak Big Build and APEX agents.
Cross-functional collaboration with Sales, Digital Marketing, Performance Data, Marketplace Affiliates and Media teams.
Visibility with senior leaders through weekly Show & Tell sessions, where you present your own work.
Professional development, networking opportunities and participation in our Early Careers community.


Our Culture

At SharkNinja, we don’t just raise the bar—we push past it every single day. Our Outrageously Extraordinary mindset drives us to tackle the impossible, push boundaries, and deliver results that others only dream of. If you thrive on breaking out of your swim lane, you’ll be right at home.

What We Offer

We offer competitive health insurance, retirement plans, paid time off, employee stock purchase options, wellness programs, SharkNinja product discounts, and more. We empower your personal and professional growth with high impact Learning Programs featuring bold voices redefining what’s possible. When you join, you’re not just part of a company—you’re part of an outrageously extraordinary community. Together, we won’t just launch products—we’ll disrupt entire markets.

At SharkNinja, Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion are vital to our global success. Valuing each unique voice and blending all of our diverse skills strengthens SharkNinja’s innovation every day. We support ALL associates in bringing their authentic selves to work, making an impact, and having the opportunity for career acceleration. With help from our leadership, associates, and our community, we aim to have equity be a key component of the SharkNinja DNA.

Learn More About Us

Outrageously Extraordinary

6. Análisis de Tendencias de Mercado: Mantenerse actualizado sobre las tendencias de consumo, competidores y cambios en el mercado digital para ajustar la estrategia comercial y comunicacional.

Remote, Mexico / LatAm

Join an official TikTok Partner driving $20M+ in monthly GMV, placing you at the forefront of the global social commerce revolution.

Enjoy the flexibility of a fully remote role within LatAm while collaborating directly with founders to scale a rapidly expanding creator roster.

Demonstrates proficiency in Google Sheets, CRM tools like Salesforce, and project management software such as Monday.com or Lark to track complex workflows.


Who are Jack & Jill?

Ok, I'll go first. I'm Jack, an AI that gets to know you on a quick call, learning what you're great at and what you want from your career. Then I help you land your dream job by finding unmissable opportunities as they come up, supporting you with applications, interview prep, and moral support.

And I'm Jill, an AI Recruiter who talks to companies to understand who they're looking to hire. Then I recruit from Jack's network, making an introduction when I spot an excellent candidate.

How does this work?


Jack's an AI agent for job searching and career coaching. He works for you.
Jill is the AI recruiter working for the company. She recruits from Jack's network.
If it's a match and the company wants to meet you, they'll make the intro. In the meantime, if you'd like, Jack will send you excellent alternatives.


We never post fake jobs

This isn't a trick. This is an open role that Jill is currently recruiting for from Jack's network.

Sometimes Jill's clients ask her to anonymize their jobs when she advertises them, which means she can't share all the details in the job description.

We appreciate this can make them look a bit suspect, but there isn't much we can do about it.

Give Jack a spin! You could land this role. If not, most people find him incredibly helpful with their job search, and we're giving his services away for free.

We work with 50+ clients, ranging in size from companies like YETI, Upside, and Nutrafol to established marquee brands like A+E Networks, Afterpay, and Stanley Black & Decker.

Role: To help us handle our increasing workload, we are looking to bring on a Senior Marketing Automation Specialist.

The candidate will be expected to work on a wide variety of projects with differing code structures. Ensure that emails comply with clients' standards, email marketing best practices, and CAN-Spam laws.

Minimum requirements to be considered:


5+ years of email production and development experience. 
Mastery of HTML and CSS specific to email. 
Proficiency with JSON. 
Knows what an API is, how it works, and is proficient in making GET and POST calls. 
Understand how a data feed works. 
Has an understanding of email code structure and knows how to make code responsive for different devices. 
Has strong email etiquette and can communicate with testing, QC, and updates directly with clients.

Platform experience with Iterable, Braze, Klaviyo, Marketo, Simon Data, or Blueshift. 
Knowledge of Liquid or Python, Handlebars, Django, or JINJA. 
Proficiency with Photoshop and Figma.

About the job

Join Vylor—Powering the Future of Agriculture

At Vylor, we’re advancing agriculture through breakthrough science—combining elite germplasm, cutting-edge biotech, and next-generation expertise in gene editing and molecular breeding. Our portfolio includes trusted industry brands like Pioneer®, Brevant®, and Hoegemeyer®, delivering performance farmers rely on.

Join us to help scale innovation globally and shape what’s next in crop science.

We are seeking a dynamic and strategic Marketing Manager to drive growth and strengthen Vylor market leadership in Meso Andean Region. This role will lead the development and execution of portfolio, pricing, demand generation, route-to-market, communications, training, and market intelligence strategies to accelerate profitable growth and enhance customer value.

Communications


Lead the development and execution of integrated communication strategies for the Seeds portfolio.

Commercial Training & Capability Development


Develop and deploy commercial training programs for sales teams, distributors, and strategic partners.

Develop forecasting models, market sizing analyses, and business performance assessments.


Demand Generation & Territory Planning


Develop and execute demand generation strategies to increase product adoption and market share.
Lead the Territory Planning processes to identify growth opportunities, prioritize investments, and optimize commercial resources.


Pricing Strategy


Develop and manage pricing strategies that maximize profitability while maintaining market competitiveness.

Product Strategy


Define portfolio strategy and product positioning for existing and future products.
Lead product lifecycle management, including launch planning, portfolio optimization, and discontinuation decisions.


Requirements


Bachelor's Degree in Agronomy, Agricultural Engineering, Business Administration, Marketing, or a related field.
MBA or advanced business degree preferred.
8+ years of progressive experience in Marketing, Product Management, Commercial Excellence, Sales, or Business Management within the Agriculture, Seeds, Crop Protection, or related industries.
Proven experience leading multifunctional teams and cross-functional projects.
Strong background in product strategy, commercial execution, pricing, and market development.


Corteva announced to separate our current advanced seed and genetics business to establish a standalone company, operating as Vylor, Inc. The process of the planned separation is anticipated to be completed the fourth quarter of 2026, subject to legal requirements and board approval. Should you accept this position, it is anticipated that, following conclusion of the separation, you would be an employee of Vylor, Inc. and your employment would be governed by Vylor, Inc. employment processes, programs, policies, and benefit plans. In that case, details of any planned changes would be provided to you by Vylor, Inc. at an appropriate time and subject to any necessary consultation processes.

Vylor is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to embracing our differences to enrich lives, advance innovation, and boost company performance. Qualified applicants will be considered without regard to race, color, religion, creed, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital status, national origin, age, military or veteran status, pregnancy related conditions (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), disability or any other protected status in accordance with federal, state, or local laws.

description:
About the job

Who we are

About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies—from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups—use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone’s reach while doing the most important work of your career.

About The Team

At Stripe, our Mexico City office is a vibrant hub at the forefront of our mission to reshape the financial landscape for businesses worldwide. Our team prioritizes collaboration, innovation, and excellence. As a member of the Mexico City team, you'll be part of a mission-driven community dedicated to enhancing the global economy and increasing the GDP of the internet. We strive for excellence by creating with craft and beauty, while having fun and celebrating our successes together.

We cultivate a culture of collaboration, inclusivity, and support where every team member’s voice matters. Our commitment shines through as we handle over a million support cases each year, empowering our users not just to solve problems but to achieve their goals.

What you’ll do

Responsibilities


Troubleshoot and solve external user issues
Analyze our processes and instigate changes to help scale our operations and improve user experience
Work closely with other Stripe teams to improve our product offerings and messaging around new products and features
Gain unique insights into how thousands of businesses on Stripe scale and operate
Have an opportunity to learn how Stripe operates from the ground up and make a real impact on the future of the organization
Be a part of building a brand-new team and operational culture for Stripe
Partner with global operations specialists or business process owners to run a critical workflow



Who you are

We’re looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.

Minimum Requirements


You have a user-first mindset and are energized by the challenge of solving difficult problems
You have excellent communication skills, both written and verbal
You excel in critical thinking and problem solving
You have prior experience in customer service or internal and external user-facing operations
You enjoy learning about technical products and processes, you're an organized, self-starter with passion for finding solutions to our user’s challenges
You have a process-oriented mindset and the ability to get things done
You enjoy working in an in-office environment with strong cross-team collaboration and support
You prioritize well and enjoy working in a quick-moving environment
You are humble and have a proven track record for working well across teams and with external partners
You're willing to periodically work a weekend day for which you'll receive a weekday off. The SDC operates during daytime hours with shifts from the morning through early evening



Preferred Qualifications


Prior experience or knowledge in user support
Prior experience working on projects or process improvement initiatives



In-office expectations

Office-assigned Stripes in most of our locations are currently expected to spend at least 50% of the time in a given month in their local office or with users. This expectation may vary depending on role, team and location. For example, Stripes in Stripe Delivery Center roles in Mexico City, Mexico, Bengaluru, India, and Dublin, Ireland work 100% from the office. Also, some teams have greater in-office attendance requirements, to appropriately support our users and workflows, which the hiring manager will discuss. This approach helps strike a balance between bringing people together for in-person collaboration and learning from each other, while supporting flexibility when possible.

Pay and benefits

Stripe does not yet include pay ranges in job postings in every country. Stripe strongly values pay transparency and is working toward pay transparency globally.

We look forward to hearing from you.

At Stripe, we're looking for people with passion, grit, and integrity. You're encouraged to apply even if your experience doesn't precisely match the job description. Your skills and passion will stand out—and set you apart—especially if your career has taken some extraordinary twists and turns. At Stripe, we welcome diverse perspectives and people who think rigorously and aren't afraid to challenge assumptions. Join us.

Apply now

About the job

We are hiring a Quality Assurance Specialist –  IT Compliance & CSV (Pharma/CRO)




At Cohortias, we are looking for a specialized QA professional to oversee our technology ecosystem. This is not a traditional clinical or manufacturing QA role, nor a general IT position—we are seeking an expert in GxP Computerized System Validation (CSV), data integrity, and technology governance within the pharmaceutical or CRO industry. 




📍 Location: Mexico City (Hybrid Model) 




About the Role:

As a Quality Assurance Specialist (GxP Systems & CSV), you will serve as the independent Quality Unit point of contact for Computerized System Validation (CSV/CSA), Data Integrity, and IT vendor governance. You will ensure that our eClinical platforms, cloud infrastructure, and software providers comply with international regulations (FDA, EMA) and GxP standards throughout their lifecycle. 




Key Responsibilities:




Provide independent QA oversight for the validation lifecycle of GxP computerized systems (CSV/CSA) under GAMP 5 guidelines. 
Monitor and evaluate compliance with electronic records and signatures regulations (21 CFR Part 11 and EU Annex 11). 
Conduct risk-based quality audits and evaluations covering information security (ISO 27001), data privacy (GDPR), and business continuity (ISO 22301) for IT and eClinical technology vendors. 
Oversee IT/GxP vendor qualification, Quality Agreements, SLAs, and change control processes. 
Review and approve root cause analyses (RCA), deviations, and CAPA plans for system and technology-related incidents. 
Drive Quality Risk Management (ICH Q9) and contribute to continuous QMS improvements and internal ALCOA+ training.

About the job

Who We Are




We are a high-growth, high-performance team driving Absolute Sales Development (Sandler Miami) and Elephant Journey. Our leaders, Carlos and Carolina, live incredibly fast-paced, demanding lives balancing CEO duties, Vistage Chair responsibilities, coaching, and their personal lives.

 

We operate on five core values: Humanity++, Boldness, Accountability, Growth Mindset, and Ambition & Drive. We care about our people first, but results follow immediately after. We are looking for an Executive Assistant who embodies this; someone who is deeply human and empathetic, but operates with relentless precision and accountability.

 

The Role

This is not a standard "virtual assistant" role where you wait to be handed tasks. You are the ultimate gatekeeper, integrator, and partner. Your primary directive is simple: take care of Carlos and Carolina’s personal and professional lives so they can maximize their leadership time and drive revenue.

 

You will work closely with our Chief of Staff to ensure that absolutely no balls are dropped. Everyone depends on leadership to guide them to the north star, and leadership depends on you to keep their path clear.

 

What You Will Own (Key Responsibilities)

 

Flawless Calendar & Time Management: Ruthlessly guard Carlos and Carolina’s time. You will manage complex, ever-changing schedules across multiple businesses (Sandler, Vistage) and personal lives.
Inbox & Communication Triage: Act as the first line of defense. You won't just forward emails; you will gather context, connect the dots, and draft responses. We move fast, and delayed responses due to "missing context" are not an option.
Logistics & Travel: Seamlessly book and manage flights, accommodations, and itineraries for business trips, client bootcamps, Traction meetings, and personal travel.

Meeting Preparation: Ensure leadership walks into every Vistage session, Sandler training, and client meeting fully prepared with the right briefs, Fathom links, and background data.

 

Who You Are (Requirements)

Hyper-Attentive to Detail: You double-check and triple-check. Precision is your baseline.
Proactive Context-Seeker: When you don't know the answer, you look for it. You know how to dig into CRMs, meeting transcripts, and project boards to find the missing puzzle pieces before asking.
Tough but Human: You hold the line on leadership's boundaries. You can say "no" to people gracefully but firmly. You align with our "Humanity++" ethos—you care about people, but you demand accountability.
Tech-Fluent: You are highly proficient in tools like Microsoft Outlook/Teams, monday.com, HubSpot, Zoom, Fathom, and comfortable adopting AI workflows.
Calm Under Pressure: Carlos and Carolina live crazy lives. You thrive in the chaos, bringing order, calm, and predictability to their days.

 

Offer and Benefits:

 

· $30,000 Base salary + end-of-year bonus.

· Paid Time Off

· Flexible & Remote Schedule




Absolute Sales Development is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, or veteran status.

You will be stepping into the inner circle of two highly successful entrepreneurs. You will be supported by a Chief of Staff who will have your back, provided you bring your A-game. También nos esforzamos por garantizar que todos los empleados y candidatos sean tratados con respeto y dignidad, basando todas las decisiones de empleo en las cualificaciones, el mérito y las necesidades del negocio.

En Publicis Groupe reconocemos la importancia de la flexibilidad en el lugar de trabajo por lo que apoyamos el trabajo híbrido, permitiendo a nuestros empleados combinar el trabajo remoto con el trabajo en la oficina, cuidando mantener la calidad de nuestras prestaciones hacía nuestros clientes."
